items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Phil Moore was his real name.

ctx.x: There was one piano player, a very good pianist, Lazy Daddy. I think he was in Galveston though. Did you remember ever hearing him? No, I don't remember that.
Phil Moore was his real name.
You all called him Lazy Daddy. No.

items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: I know the man who had sent him for him to play... But I don't know the name of the band

ctx.x: Phil Moore was his real name.
You all called him Lazy Daddy. No.

I know the man who had sent him for him to play, who he was playing with over there, the man's name was Minor Brown. But I don't know the name of the band because I'm not good on remembering too long. It's different things.
